Task 7: the provider-path matrix (7 worker + 2 provider failpoints, kills at hits with a model job unfinished) runs the production preparer, persisted review batch, reservation and a real bounded child; the restarted worker reaps a curator tree its killed predecessor left and the store equals the reference. variants.notes: Task 12a: JSON stdout is exactly one object for success, partial capability and every error class; `observe` returns 7 when durability was not acknowledged (valid input) and lists accepted event IDs otherwise; status/doctor and degraded context packets return 8 with registered reasons; unavailable forms return 4 naming their owner. Packet `why` reason codes are validated by the strict ContextItem (Task 11). Host hooks' nonblocking delivery branch is Task 12b. Task 12b: real hook processes with delivery always exit 0 with empty stdout or exactly one `hookSpecificOutput` envelope (additional context only, never a decision or a block); every emitted item's first why is a registered reason code. Task 17: status/doctor exit 0 only when ready and 8 otherwise, naming the reasons of each required capability that is not healthy; health_composition_unavailable retired.

cases.scenario: Administrative guard, pre-init tokens and internal startup
cases.required_behavior: Marked host/worker/curator processes get exit 6 for all guarded forms, including token commands and profile flags, even with TTY+token. No requested admin effect; content-free audit when store available. Unmarked TTY can create a standalone token before init; noninteractive init with that provisioned file succeeds once and never overwrites existing state. Missing/invalid/revoked supplied token is 6, not 2; noninteractive minting refuses. Registered hook startup succeeds without operator CLI. Marked IDE error explains the external-terminal route; pre-init refusal creates no store

variants.description: Applies in full to both profiles
variants.notes: Task 4 permitted-start control plus the Task 12a CLI guard: every agent-refusable form (30 spellings of DATA_CONTRACTS §12) is exit 6 for host/worker/curator-marked callers with and without terminal and token, through the launcher and both module spellings, with no requested effect and a content-free audit; unmarked noninteractive callers are refused; pre-init token minting needs a terminal and no installation lookup; noninteractive init with a provisioned token succeeds once; bad/revoked tokens are 6 without terminal fallback; audit failure still refuses; pre-init refusal creates nothing; the hook still starts the worker without the CLI. Simulated markers and terminals are controlled test states: a live operator workflow from a real IDE host and Task 13's host command-pattern deny rules remain (requires_live_host). Task 13: certified deny rules denied all 29 covered commands on the real host; the gap spellings reached the CLI on the actual tool subprocess (CLAUDECODE and CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION inherited) and the guard refused them with a captured audit; no admin effect. Task 18: the evaluation harness's token init route gets the guard's refusal from a host-marked process; it never mints a token or clears a marker.
